entries.description: With no active rules, a pull request that touches harness.yaml fails until a code owner adds protected-change-approved after the latest push, and fails again when that label is older than a new push.
An active pull_request rule with require_code_owner_review true makes the same pull request exit 0, and the output names the ruleset source and id.
An HTTP 500 from the rules API, and a missing token, each exit 2 on a harness.yaml pull request with no label. The output names the cause. Neither exits 0.
protected-change and platform-rules import the same rule-reading module, and harness/ has one definition of the rule-type mapping.
A DROP TABLE line outside protected paths fails until it is labelled, whether or not the rules API returns a code owner rule. A-119 still passes.
A harness.yaml pull request whose rules response is missing type exits 2. The output names that field. It does not exit 0.
